def original_runtime_seed(review, oldbase):
    # The protected recipe replaces bootstrap and adds metadata; it does not
    # replace seed. Authenticate seed's actual original baseline independently.
    digest = '3051dea5ccc9d74126bf71ddc0bb72a4d3db19c59f890a8f48d572b215f092af'
    expected = Path(oldbase['baselineApp']) / 'Contents/Resources/aux' / PREFIX / 'runtime-seed.cjs'
    reference = review['inputs']['originalRuntimeSeed']
    require(reference['path'] == str(expected) and reference['sha256'] == digest,
            'Exact original baseline seed required')
    require(not expected.is_symlink(), 'Original seed may not be redirected')
    m.pin(expected, digest)
    historical_path = ROOT / 'docs/integration/proposed/browser-feature-expansion/runtime-cache-package-a4/prepared/runtime-integration.json'
    historical_digest = '049e6e4046b9933b7edd4d4950005f4a460acc6fc171c94daa476286d0e79e70'
    historical_reference = review['inputs']['originalRuntimeSeedEvidence']
    require(historical_reference == dict(path=str(historical_path), sha256=historical_digest),
            'Exact historical seed association required')
    m.pin(historical_path, historical_digest)
    historical = read(historical_path)
    require(historical['format'] == 'aux.runtime-cache-package.runtime.v1', 'Historical runtime manifest changed')
    seeds = [item for item in historical['runtimeIntegration'] if item['path'] == PREFIX + 'runtime-seed.cjs']
    require(len(seeds) == 1 and seeds[0]['previousSha256'] == digest
            and seeds[0]['sha256'] == '54bd9cf68d25b9db0827af32ad323ea03821f7adae4066b677849a3e5b28a039'
            and seeds[0]['mustBeAbsent'] is False and seeds[0]['mode'] == 0o644,
            'Historical original seed replacement association changed')
    return digest
